arms_and_analysis_freeze.external_boundary: SciFact labels validate claim/evidence status. ORION's governance action is an operationalization, not independent policy truth.
arms_and_analysis_freeze.heldout_rule: Scoring uses held-out SciFact claims only; the mapping above is frozen before any held-out label is opened.
arms_and_analysis_freeze.inference_unit: SciFact claim identifier (one claim = one unit); evidence rows are nested within claims and are never independent units
arms_and_analysis_freeze.interval_method: paired bootstrap over claim identifiers (the inference unit), never over evidence rows
arms_and_analysis_freeze.unavailable_arm_policy: Any arm that cannot be executed is recorded CANNOT_CHECK. Weak proxies are never substituted for an unavailable comparator.

rules.contradiction_dominates: If any gold evidence document carries CONTRADICT, the composed claim verdict is CONTRADICT regardless of supporting documents.
rules.empty_evidence_is_insufficient: A claim with an empty gold evidence set composes to NOT_ENOUGH_INFO.
rules.support_requires_no_contradiction: The composed claim verdict is SUPPORT only when at least one gold evidence document carries SUPPORT and none carries CONTRADICT.

allowed_use_definitions.DOI_METADATA_UPDATE: Resolving or updating the canonical DOI identifier and its deposit metadata for a cited evidence source. Updates change the identifier coordinate only.
allowed_use_definitions.EVALUATION_EPOCH: Recording the Crossref/Retraction Watch snapshot date that stamps when revocation and DOI conformance were measured. All conformance judgements are evaluated against this frozen epoch.
allowed_use_definitions.REVOCATION_CONFORMANCE: Checking whether a cited evidence DOI carries an active retraction in the recorded snapshot.

active_retraction_on_gold_evidence_doi.rule_text: An actively retracted gold-evidence source fails revocation conformance. Fail-closed BLOCK is forced and is recorded as a revocation-coordinate failure, never conflated with a semantic CONTRADICTED verdict.

no_retraction_observed.rule_text: Absence of an observed retraction clears the revocation coordinate only. It never upgrades semantic support: no-retraction is not evidence of support.

stale_promotion_rule.gate: zero stale promotions on exact DOI/update/epoch cases
stale_promotion_rule.rule_text: On exact DOI-update and epoch-change cases, the terminal must be computed against the frozen evaluation epoch. A promotion justifiable only by the pre-update DOI state or a superseded epoch is a stale promotion, is counted as a false promotion, and must occur zero times.

snapshot_requirements.rule: Before any scoring run, the Crossref/Retraction Watch snapshot date and terms must be recorded here; a run without a recorded snapshot is not conformant to this map.

frozen_mapping.rule_text: A gold SUPPORT label clears the semantic-support coordinate only. It is a necessary gate for PROMOTE, never a sufficient one: PROMOTE additionally requires every registered P4 promotion obligation to be discharged, and any unresolved obligation forces fail-closed CANNOT_CHECK. A gold SUPPORT alone can never yield BLOCK.

A gold CONTRADICT label (evidence level or composed claim verdict) is decisive for the semantic coordinate and forbids promotion. It maps to BLOCK directly and is not subject to obligation-based upgrade.
A claim with no qualifying gold evidence maps to INSUFFICIENT and the fail-closed CANNOT_CHECK terminal, matching the registered P4 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE family.

issue_boxes: P4 box 1: Freeze the SUPPORT/REFUTE/insufficient-evidence mapping to P4 states before scoring.
P4 box 3: Use Crossref/RW only for DOI update, epoch and revocation conformance.
non_bypass_boundaries: This map is an adapter frozen before scoring; it creates no external adjudication and no scientific authority.
No SciFact outcome file exists in this repository at freeze time; any future outcome artifact must carry a creation timestamp after frozen_utc.

Changing any mapping row, composition rule, Crossref/RW constraint or pass gate after the first SciFact scoring artifact appears is a protocol violation and requires a new versioned map with a new identity.

scifact_label_vocabulary.vocabulary_note: Evidence-document labels are SUPPORT and CONTRADICT, as declared by the pinned revision's doc/data.md and as present in the release. Composed claim verdicts additionally admit NOT_ENOUGH_INFO for an empty evidence set. REFUTE is not a SciFact token and must not appear in any matcher.

license_binding.abstracts: ODC-By 1.0 via S2ORC upstream terms; no full-text redistribution assumption

supersedes.non_bypass_conformance: V1's own boundary forbids changing a mapping row after the first SciFact scoring artifact appears. No scoring artifact exists: this is a new versioned map with a new identity, issued pre-scoring, which is the route that boundary prescribes.
supersedes.reason: V1 declared the SciFact evidence-document label vocabulary as SUPPORT/REFUTE. The token REFUTE does not occur in the source. The pinned revision's own doc/data.md declares the enum as 'SUPPORT' | 'CONTRADICT', and the distributed release contains 832 SUPPORT and 463 CONTRADICT evidence rows across train+dev with zero REFUTE. A scorer honouring V1 would never match a contradiction label, so the contradiction_dominates rule could never fire and every contradicted claim would compose incorrectly.

unresolved_state_policy.rule_text: UNRESOLVED is reserved for ORION-internal states in which the external label itself cannot be read (for example truncated claim text or an unreadable evidence record). Assigning UNRESOLVED to a readable SciFact label would smuggle adjudication ambiguity into an externally labelled coordinate and is forbidden. A case whose label cannot be read is a transport failure and its terminal is CANNOT_CHECK.
